symptom: `mxcli check -p … --references` warned MDL-WIDGET10 "property `attributes` is hidden when `attrChoice` is \"auto\" — the value will be ignored" on every `textfilter`/`numberfilter`/`datefilter` with `Attributes: [...]`, although exec stores the list and attrChoice "linked" (ako/mxcli#1684)
cause: text/number/date filter .def.json declared attrChoice as the constant "auto"; the builder's SetAttributeObjects silently flips it to "linked" when it fills the list, so widgetValueMap (which only reads the definition) evaluated the editorConfig rule against a configuration exec never writes
file: `sdk/widgets/definitions/{text,number,date}filter.def.json` (new `attributes` mode on `hasAttributes`: attrChoice=linked + attributes; `default` mode keeps auto)
insight: **A builder side effect the definition does not state is invisible to check.** Any Set* that writes a second property (here SetAttributeObjects → attrChoice) must be mirrored as a mode constant, or MDL-WIDGET10 and the hidden-property reset reason about a configuration nobody stores. #1519 fixed the drop-down filter this way and left its three siblings; grep the defs for a constant the builder also writes when fixing one. Only reproduces with a project (rules come from the .mpk; testdata/pedapp's lifts 0 rules), so test the value map plus a supplied rule, with a control rule that hides under "linked".
